correctness.rationale: Independent float64 replay from closed-form torus-of-revolution formula reproduces all 20 census values to <1e-9 and all lie inside claimed intervals; copied stdlib verifier reports ALL CHECKS PASS (closedness, chi=0, containment, per-vertex sums, extremal disjointness). Extremal T88 [18.42167687,18.42184051] is disjoint below runner-up A89 [18.51803559,18.51821423] by 0.0961950758, ~588x the extremal width (1.64e-4). Icosahedron control replays W=0.0 exactly confirming Mobius normalization sum beta - pi|V|; torus V-E+F=0 verified; T* per-vertex sum matches total; total angle defect 7.1e-15; refinement spot-checks 16x16:19.3348802058, 24x24:19.5503738977, 32x32:19.6309907590 match DRAFT to 6dp and increase toward 2pi^2=19.7392088022 from below; square column 8->12 monotone increasing verified; aspect sweep minimum at 1.35 verified; beta endpoint-independence verified (diff 0 on torus meshes). DRAFT rounding of intervals and gap [-1.317532,-1.317369] verified. Limitations are stated honestly (surveyed-family extremality only, diagonal-split only, sqrt2 as float 1.4142135623730951, naive intervals, no smooth claim). Interval-generator code (interval.py) was not archived so lo/hi soundness itself was not re-derived, but float containment + margin >> width >> plausible FP error (~1e-12) makes the separation inequality robust; this is a finite-computation certificate with independent replay, not a general theorem.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison of four nearest priors, all retrieved live: (1) Marques-Neves arXiv:1202.6036 proves smooth W>=2pi^2 with Clifford equality (96pp min-max theory) - contains no discrete triangulation values and does not imply finite-resolution gaps, which lie below 2pi^2 here. (2) Bobenko math/0406128 defines the Mobius-invariant discrete functional W=sum beta-pi|V| and thin-shell bending energy - provides the evaluation definition but no 8x8-12x12 torus census or separated extremal. (3) Bobenko-Weidner arXiv:1505.08054 studies different quadratic functionals W2=sum beta^2 and W2,w for spheres and nontrivial topologies with isolated inscribed-minimizer experiments and geometry-processing applications - no per-resolution Bobenko-W gap table with interval separation over the claimed 20-mesh window. (4) Knoeppel et al arXiv:2311.02241 gives rolling-spheres/quaternionic theory of Bobenko energy only, no extremal census. None records, implies, or mechanically yields the explicit T* value 18.421677, the 0.0962 separation, the monotone square column, or the aspect-sweep table.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural motivated object: Bobenko discrete Willmore energy of diagonal-split tori of revolution on 8x8-12x12 grids, motivated before computation by the Marques-Neves 2pi^2 stability picture, Bobenko thin-shell bending energy, and Bobenko-Weidner geometry-processing minimizers. The values were not known or mechanically implied (smooth theorem gives no discrete values; coarse meshes lie strictly below 2pi^2 with non-monotone grid/aspect dependence requiring computation). The certified interval-separated lowest-among-surveyed extremal T* plus full 20-mesh calibration table, per-vertex logs, committed vertex/face lists, and stdlib verifier form a reusable small-grid calibration and audit pipeline for Willmore-flow/thin-shell codes that a future researcher could reasonably retrieve. Honestly scoped as surveyed-family extremality, not all triangulated tori; incompleteness does not erase the headline datum. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

residual_risks: Interval-generator code (interval.py with rational trig reduction/Taylor remainders/nextafter padding) was not archived; lo/hi soundness was checked only via float containment, not by re-deriving enclosures. Risk mitigated by margin (0.096) >> widths (~2-4e-4) >> FP error (~1e-12).
Scope is explicitly limited to diagonal-split tori of revolution on 20 listed grids/aspects; staggered/criss-cross patterns and general triangulated tori are excluded by design.
R/r=sqrt(2) is the float 1.4142135623730951, not symbolic sqrt(2); energy sensitivity to the ~1e-16 aspect error is negligible but not separately enclosed in archived artifacts.
Refinement values 16x16/24x24/32x32 are float64-only supporting observations, not interval-certified in the census.
